 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs/task-a6e3515c.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Extend each color in the top three-cell marker down, then toward its matching edge marker."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    nonzero = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0]
    if not nonzero:
        return out
    for col, color in nonzero:
        # A matching perimeter mark determines the elbow row and horizontal direction.
        targets = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                   if grid[r][c] == color and (r == h - 1 or c == 0 or c == w - 1)
                   and not (r == 0 and c == col)]
        if targets:
            # Markers are expected on the left or right edge; prioritize the edge target.
            r, c = targets[0]
            if c == 0 or c == w - 1:
                for rr in range(1, r + 1):
                    out[rr][col] = color
                for cc in range(min(col, c), max(col, c) + 1):
                    out[r][cc] = color
            else:
                # Bottom-edge marker: continue vertically to it.
                for rr in range(1, r + 1):
                    out[rr][col] = color
        else:
            for rr in range(1, h):
                out[rr][col] = color
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = [[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
    demo[0][5:8] = [6,5,3]
    demo[4][0] = 6
    demo[2][14] = 3
    # Verify defining line behavior for demo and test-style layout.
    got = transform(demo)
    assert all(got[r][5] == 6 for r in range(5))
    assert all(got[4][c] == 6 for c in range(6))
    assert all(got[r][6] == 5 for r in range(15))
    assert all(got[2][c] == 3 for c in range(7,15))
    assert all(got[r][7] == 3 for r in range(3))
    test = [[0]*11 for _ in range(11)]
    test[0][3:6] = [4,8,5]
    test[7][0] = 4
    test[9][10] = 5
    result = transform(test)
    assert all(result[r][3] == 4 for r in range(8))
    assert all(result[7][c] == 4 for c in range(4))
    assert all(result[r][4] == 8 for r in range(11))
    assert all(result[r][5] == 5 for r in range(10))
    assert all(result[9][c] == 5 for c in range(5,11))
    print(result)
",
 "cross_profile": false
